_meta.description: Real Gmail users.watch() response (gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/watch). Per the Users.watch reference the body is exactly {"historyId": <string>, "expiration": <string>} where BOTH values are numbers serialized as strings: historyId is the mailbox's current history bookmark, expiration is a ms-since-epoch timestamp. A watch RENEWAL can return a LOWER historyId than the push/poll fetchers have already advanced the stored cursor to — the watch_scheduler must keep GREATEST(stored, returned) (numeric compare on the stringified ids) so the cursor never rewinds. Doc-derived; values are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest/v1/users/watch (response body: historyId string, expiration string ms-epoch; users.watch may be re-issued to renew)
